Chinese Peas
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 5:15pm

Ingredients




pound Chinese pea pods
1 tablespoon Oil
cup Waterchesnuts, Sliced
1 cup Chicken broth
1 tablespoon Cornstarch
2 tablespoons Cold water Salt Soy sauc

Preparation

1 **Serve these sparkling peas alongside any main dish, it doesn't have to be Chinese. 2 Snap ends from pea pods and remove strings. Heat oil in skillet. Add peas, water chestnuts and stock. Cover and cook over high heat 3 minutes. Combine cornstarch and cold water. Push vegetables to one side and add cornstarch mixture to liquid. Cook, stirring, until slightly thickened. Season to taste with salt. Serve with soy sauce, if desired.
